proposals.source: Audited T14 control repetitions and incomplete T15
proposals.summary: Freeze independent warmup policies, test unseen content and shapes, separate startup/cache costs and enforce denominator/percentile/dirty-byte provenance.
Executable guards reject warm-control, P50, source-overlay, incomplete-matrix, missing-quality and near-miss promotion; preserve explicit claim corrections.
Require pinned-image live-symbol resolution plus parent/worker/rank execution proof and a disabled control.

proposals.source: Qwen3.5 MMAR round0 and IPC fullmesh failures
proposals.summary: Require overlap-safe interval unions, isolated-versus-service envelope comparison, explicit buffer ownership, epochs, global rank decisions, and lifecycle stress.
Limit quality claims to the strongest available oracle and require complete paired review when reference answers are absent.

proposals.source: Qwen3.5 repeated candidate and denominator history
proposals.summary: Separate promising ingredients from promotable final bytes and record phase-boundary movement across successor failures.
Record runtime-path, profiler-overlap, collective-ownership, quality-oracle, and evidence-scope lessons without claiming the final target.
Distinguish artifact provenance, architecture metadata, live loaded bytes, and service aliases; keep heavyweight hashing outside measured latency windows.

proposals.source: Qwen3.8 TP8 long baseline and interference audit
proposals.summary: Preserve contaminated cells, serialize long matrices, hash every finalized unit, and recompute summaries from immutable cell evidence.
Treat configuration changes as named candidates and topology/model/dtype changes as new deployment denominators unless explicitly declared otherwise.
Preserve valid partial quality rows but require the declared population for final scoring, and separate model-quality, transport, lifecycle, scorer and cleanup failures.
